title: Bar Assistant 6.0.0-rc1 before 6.11.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in CocktailController::copy…
description: Bar Assistant versions from 6.0.0-rc1 up to but not including 6.11.0 contain an authorization vulnerability in the CocktailController::copy function. This flaw allows registered users who own a bar to bypass membership checks and copy private cocktail recipes and images from other bars by sending a crafted POST request. The issue is fixed in version 6.11.0.
